summary: Corrective round for LEGION-107 after the production-hour check (LEGION-101 comment 53813157): the ResendLedger dropped a capped entry at the cap, so a second listener's late failure report for the same message restarted the chain at attempt 1 one second after the cap line (83 re-sends vs 11 cap lines, 01:04-06:04Z on 2026-09-15). Per spec version 7, a capped entry is now KEPT until RESEND_LEDGER_TTL_MS; every later claim inside the window answers `capped` (justCapped=false), refreshes the TTL clock, and the caller does nothing — no probe, no pause, no directive, no publish, no log line; only a whole quiet window forgets the message. `resendToRootArchitect` consults the ledger before the liveness probe and logs the cap line only on `justCapped`. AGENTS.md's exception-lane bullet states the rule (and restores #1085's sentences LEGION-24 #1031 had dropped). No LegionDaemonApi/pane/state-schema change; tier T3.

trickyParts: The spec says a capped message costs 'no probe'; plan decision D4 had the liveness probe before the ledger claim so a dead root resurrects on every reason. Resolution: claim first (pure, cheap), return on `capped`; a non-capped exception still probes before its pause (dead -> resurrect at once, with settle so the entry is not left in flight). A dead root whose only traffic is a capped message is the resync backstop's, which the cap line names.
The cap line must fire exactly once per chain: the ledger reports `justCapped` on the transition (entry.capped false -> true) so the caller needs no state of its own.

LEGION-24 (#1031, d30f820c) had removed #1085's AGENTS.md exception-lane paragraph and the three worker-queued sentences in its own conflict resolution (verified: parent has `receipt_timeout` once, d30f820c has none; the resend-ledger.ts file-table row survived). Restored here alongside the new cap rule; called out in the PR body so the reviewer does not read it as scope creep.
The fixture's `now` is fixed; the TTL-expiry step in the new processes test injects a mutable `now` through the manager() deps.
